title: Cloudflare: Stay discoverable in search while disallowing AI training
title_zh: Cloudflare发布防止AI训练的搜索引擎可发现性方法

paragraphs.en: This post is also available in Deutsch , Español , Español (Latinoamérica) , Français , 日本語 , 한국어 , 繁體中文 , 简体中文 , and Nederlands .
paragraphs.zh: 本文章也提供以下语言版本：Deutsch、Español、Español (Latinoamérica)、Français、日本語、한국어、繁體中文、简体中文，以及 Nederlands。

paragraphs.en: Without proper controls, website owners have long faced a difficult tradeoff: allow your content to be used for AI training, or risk losing discoverability in search. That tradeoff exists because some of the largest organizations on the Internet use mixed-use crawlers: a single crawler serving both search and AI training. Refuse one, and you refuse the other.
paragraphs.zh: 在缺乏妥善控制机制的情况下，网站所有者长期以来面临一个艰难的权衡：要么允许自己的内容被用于 AI 训练，要么冒着在搜索中失去可发现性的风险。 之所以存在这种权衡，是因为互联网上一些最大的组织使用的是混合用途的爬虫：同一个爬虫既服务于搜索，也服务于 AI 训练。 拒绝其一，就等于拒绝了另一个。

sents.en: Without proper controls, website owners have long faced a difficult tradeoff: allow your content to be used for AI training, or risk losing discoverability in search.
sents.zh: 在缺乏妥善控制机制的情况下，网站所有者长期以来面临一个艰难的权衡：要么允许自己的内容被用于 AI 训练，要么冒着在搜索中失去可发现性的风险。

sents.en: That tradeoff exists because some of the largest organizations on the Internet use mixed-use crawlers: a single crawler serving both search and AI training.
sents.zh: 之所以存在这种权衡，是因为互联网上一些最大的组织使用的是混合用途的爬虫：同一个爬虫既服务于搜索，也服务于 AI 训练。

sents.en: Refuse one, and you refuse the other.
sents.zh: 拒绝其一，就等于拒绝了另一个。

paragraphs.en: Today, Cloudflare is announcing a new Disallow AI Training setting that lets you easily stay indexed for search while refusing to let that same crawler train on your content. Apple, Google, and Microsoft honor or have committed (in a specified time frame) to honor this setting.
paragraphs.zh: 今天，Cloudflare 宣布推出全新的「禁止 AI 训练」（Disallow AI Training）设置，让你在保持被搜索索引的同时，拒绝同一爬虫使用你的内容进行训练。 Apple、Google 和 Microsoft 均遵守或已承诺（在指定时间内）遵守此设置。

sents.en: Today, Cloudflare is announcing a new Disallow AI Training setting that lets you easily stay indexed for search while refusing to let that same crawler train on your content.
sents.zh: 今天，Cloudflare 宣布推出全新的「禁止 AI 训练」（Disallow AI Training）设置，让你在保持被搜索索引的同时，拒绝同一爬虫使用你的内容进行训练。

sents.en: Apple, Google, and Microsoft honor or have committed (in a specified time frame) to honor this setting.
sents.zh: Apple、Google 和 Microsoft 均遵守或已承诺（在指定时间内）遵守此设置。

paragraphs.en: Mixed-use crawlers were the hard part of the training question. AI Summaries are next. A site-wide yes or no is too blunt: how much of your content appears in a summary matters as much as whether it appears at all. An opt-out for AI summaries is already one of the requirements we've set for mixed-use crawler operators. By early next year, our goal is to let you control how much of your content is included — set once on Cloudflare, rather than with each operator separately.
paragraphs.zh: 混合用途爬虫是训练难题中最棘手的部分。AI 摘要则是下一个挑战。 全站一刀切的允许或禁止太过粗糙：你的内容有多少出现在摘要中，与它是否出现同样重要。 针对 AI 摘要的选择退出机制，已经是我们为混合用途爬虫运营方设定的要求之一。 到明年初，我们的目标是让你能够控制自己的内容有多少被纳入其中——只需在 Cloudflare 上设置一次，而不必分别与每个运营方逐一协商。

sents.en: Mixed-use crawlers were the hard part of the training question. AI Summaries are next.
sents.zh: 混合用途爬虫是训练难题中最棘手的部分。AI 摘要则是下一个挑战。

sents.en: A site-wide yes or no is too blunt: how much of your content appears in a summary matters as much as whether it appears at all.
sents.zh: 全站一刀切的允许或禁止太过粗糙：你的内容有多少出现在摘要中，与它是否出现同样重要。

sents.en: An opt-out for AI summaries is already one of the requirements we've set for mixed-use crawler operators.
sents.zh: 针对 AI 摘要的选择退出机制，已经是我们为混合用途爬虫运营方设定的要求之一。

sents.en: By early next year, our goal is to let you control how much of your content is included — set once on Cloudflare, rather than with each operator separately.
sents.zh: 到明年初，我们的目标是让你能够控制自己的内容有多少被纳入其中——只需在 Cloudflare 上设置一次，而不必分别与每个运营方逐一协商。

paragraphs.en: Most site owners want to be found: by humans, agents, and (good) bots. But a significant portion of the open Internet is funded by advertising, subscriptions, or direct relationships with visitors, and those models only pay when someone actually arrives.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数网站所有者都希望被发现：被人类、智能体以及（善意的）机器人发现。 但开放互联网中很大一部分是依靠广告、订阅或与访客的直接关系来获得资金的，而这些模式只有在有人真正到访时才会有收益。

sents.en: Most site owners want to be found: by humans, agents, and (good) bots.
sents.zh: 大多数网站所有者都希望被发现：被人类、智能体以及（善意的）机器人发现。

sents.en: But a significant portion of the open Internet is funded by advertising, subscriptions, or direct relationships with visitors, and those models only pay when someone actually arrives.
sents.zh: 但开放互联网中很大一部分是依靠广告、订阅或与访客的直接关系来获得资金的，而这些模式只有在有人真正到访时才会有收益。

paragraphs.en: Almost every site owner considers Search beneficial: less than 1% of Cloudflare sites choose to block Search bots. Training, however, is a different story: 17% of sites choose to enable some mechanism to block training. This is exactly why we decided site owners needed more granular controls, rather than a one-size-fits-all “Block AI.”
paragraphs.zh: 几乎每个网站所有者都认为搜索是有益的：不到 1% 的 Cloudflare 网站选择屏蔽搜索机器人。 然而，训练则是另一回事：17% 的网站选择启用某种机制来屏蔽训练。 这正是我们决定网站所有者需要更细粒度控制，而不是一刀切的「屏蔽 AI」的原因。

sents.en: Almost every site owner considers Search beneficial: less than 1% of Cloudflare sites choose to block Search bots.
sents.zh: 几乎每个网站所有者都认为搜索是有益的：不到 1% 的 Cloudflare 网站选择屏蔽搜索机器人。

sents.en: Training, however, is a different story: 17% of sites choose to enable some mechanism to block training.
sents.zh: 然而，训练则是另一回事：17% 的网站选择启用某种机制来屏蔽训练。

sents.en: This is exactly why we decided site owners needed more granular controls, rather than a one-size-fits-all “Block AI.”
sents.zh: 这正是我们决定网站所有者需要更细粒度控制，而不是一刀切的「屏蔽 AI」的原因。

paragraphs.en: A robots.txt directive alone cannot solve this problem. Anyone can publish one, but it cannot identify who is crawling, determine why they are crawling, or stop a crawler that ignores it.
paragraphs.zh: 仅凭 robots.txt 指令无法解决这个问题。 任何人都可以发布一个，但它无法识别正在爬取的是谁、无法判断其爬取的原因，也无法阻止无视它的爬虫。

sents.en: A robots.txt directive alone cannot solve this problem.
sents.zh: 仅凭 robots.txt 指令无法解决这个问题。

sents.en: Anyone can publish one, but it cannot identify who is crawling, determine why they are crawling, or stop a crawler that ignores it.
sents.zh: 任何人都可以发布一个，但它无法识别正在爬取的是谁、无法判断其爬取的原因，也无法阻止无视它的爬虫。

paragraphs.en: A network can solve it, however: we publish the preference, identify who is crawling, classify why they are crawling, and block the ones that ignore it – then report what each operator actually does on Radar .
paragraphs.zh: 不过，网络可以解决这个问题：我们发布偏好声明，识别谁在抓取，分类他们抓取的原因，并屏蔽那些无视偏好的智能体——然后在 Radar 上报告每个运营方实际的行为。

paragraphs.en: But blocking removes a crawler. It doesn't change how crawlers behave. The better outcome is operators that don't make you choose at all. So since July, we've been talking to them directly. The response has been encouraging: almost all agreed that site owners should have control and transparency into how their content is used, and reassurance that their choices will be respected. To help site owners understand that, we created a designation: Accountable.
paragraphs.zh: 但封锁只能移除一个爬虫。 它并不能改变爬虫的行为方式。 更好的结果是那些根本不让你做出选择的运营者。 因此从七月开始，我们一直在与他们直接沟通。 回应令人鼓舞：几乎所有运营者都同意网站所有者应当对其内容如何被使用拥有控制权和透明度，并确保他们的选择会得到尊重。 为了帮助网站所有者理解这一点，我们创建了一个标识：Accountable（负责任）。

sents.en: But blocking removes a crawler.
sents.zh: 但封锁只能移除一个爬虫。

sents.en: It doesn't change how crawlers behave.
sents.zh: 它并不能改变爬虫的行为方式。

sents.en: The better outcome is operators that don't make you choose at all.
sents.zh: 更好的结果是那些根本不让你做出选择的运营者。

sents.en: So since July, we've been talking to them directly.
sents.zh: 因此从七月开始，我们一直在与他们直接沟通。

sents.en: The response has been encouraging: almost all agreed that site owners should have control and transparency into how their content is used, and reassurance that their choices will be respected.
sents.zh: 回应令人鼓舞：几乎所有运营者都同意网站所有者应当对其内容如何被使用拥有控制权和透明度，并确保他们的选择会得到尊重。

sents.en: To help site owners understand that, we created a designation: Accountable.
sents.zh: 为了帮助网站所有者理解这一点，我们创建了一个标识：Accountable（负责任）。

paragraphs.zh: 苹果、谷歌和微软都证明了它们符合承担责任方的资格。 每家公司都将目前可用的能力与针对仍在开发中的能力所做出的有时限承诺相结合。 以下是这几家公司各自爬虫的详细信息。

sents.zh: 苹果、谷歌和微软都证明了它们符合承担责任方的资格。

paragraphs.zh: Cloudflare 根据行为对机器人进行分类，同一个机器人可能表现出不止一种行为。 有三种行为可作为控制选项：

sents.en: Cloudflare classifies bots by behavior, and a single bot can exhibit more than one behavior.
sents.zh: Cloudflare 根据行为对机器人进行分类，同一个机器人可能表现出不止一种行为。

sents.en: Three behaviors are available as controls:
sents.zh: 有三种行为可作为控制选项：

paragraphs.en: A mixed-use crawler is a single crawler doing both Search and Training. Without controls, that combination creates the tradeoff described above: site owners cannot refuse one use without refusing the other.
paragraphs.zh: 混合用途爬虫是指同时执行搜索和训练两种用途的单一爬虫。 在没有控制机制的情况下，这种组合会造成上述的权衡困境：网站所有者无法只拒绝其中一种用途而接受另一种用途。

sents.en: A mixed-use crawler is a single crawler doing both Search and Training.
sents.zh: 混合用途爬虫是指同时执行搜索和训练两种用途的单一爬虫。

sents.en: Without controls, that combination creates the tradeoff described above: site owners cannot refuse one use without refusing the other.
sents.zh: 在没有控制机制的情况下，这种组合会造成上述的权衡困境：网站所有者无法只拒绝其中一种用途而接受另一种用途。

paragraphs.en: To avoid blocking Accountable mixed-use crawlers — the ones that don't force that tradeoff on website owners — we are introducing a new setting: Disallow AI Training. Disallow AI Training is named for the Disallow: directive it publishes in your robots.txt.
paragraphs.zh: 为了避免阻塞可问责的混合用途爬虫——即那些不把这种权衡强加给网站所有者的爬虫——我们将引入一个新设置：禁止 AI 训练。 禁止 AI 训练以它在你的 robots.txt 中发布的 Disallow: 指令命名。

sents.en: To avoid blocking Accountable mixed-use crawlers — the ones that don't force that tradeoff on website owners — we are introducing a new setting: Disallow AI Training.
sents.zh: 为了避免阻塞可问责的混合用途爬虫——即那些不把这种权衡强加给网站所有者的爬虫——我们将引入一个新设置：禁止 AI 训练。

sents.en: Disallow AI Training is named for the Disallow: directive it publishes in your robots.txt.
sents.zh: 禁止 AI 训练以它在你的 robots.txt 中发布的 Disallow: 指令命名。

paragraphs.en: Block and “Block on pages with ads” previously did not apply to mixed-use crawlers because blocking them could also affect search discoverability. Now that we have the new Disallow AI Training setting, Block and “Block on pages with ads” apply to all training crawlers, including mixed-use crawlers.
paragraphs.zh: 「屏蔽」和「在有广告的页面上屏蔽」此前不适用于混合用途爬虫，因为屏蔽它们也可能影响搜索可发现性。 既然我们推出了新的「禁止 AI 训练」设置，「屏蔽」和「在有广告的页面上屏蔽」现在适用于所有训练爬虫，包括混合用途爬虫。

sents.en: Block and “Block on pages with ads” previously did not apply to mixed-use crawlers because blocking them could also affect search discoverability.
sents.zh: 「屏蔽」和「在有广告的页面上屏蔽」此前不适用于混合用途爬虫，因为屏蔽它们也可能影响搜索可发现性。

sents.en: Now that we have the new Disallow AI Training setting, Block and “Block on pages with ads” apply to all training crawlers, including mixed-use crawlers.
sents.zh: 既然我们推出了新的「禁止 AI 训练」设置，「屏蔽」和「在有广告的页面上屏蔽」现在适用于所有训练爬虫，包括混合用途爬虫。

sents.en: Training, Search, and Agent controls are applied at the domain level.
sents.zh: 训练、搜索和智能体控制在域名级别应用。

paragraphs.en: Disallow AI Training works by publishing a preference in robots.txt. An ads-only preference cannot be expressed that way: Cloudflare can detect which pages serve ads, but that list is too large and changes too frequently to enumerate in robots.txt. That's why there's no Disallow AI Training on pages with ads.
paragraphs.zh: 禁止 AI 训练的方式是通过在 robots.txt 中发布一条偏好声明来实现的。 仅针对广告的偏好无法用这种方式表达：Cloudflare 可以检测哪些页面投放了广告，但这份列表太庞大且变化过于频繁，无法在 robots.txt 中逐一列出。 这就是为什么对于投放广告的页面没有「禁止 AI 训练」选项。

sents.en: Disallow AI Training works by publishing a preference in robots.txt.
sents.zh: 禁止 AI 训练的方式是通过在 robots.txt 中发布一条偏好声明来实现的。

sents.en: An ads-only preference cannot be expressed that way: Cloudflare can detect which pages serve ads, but that list is too large and changes too frequently to enumerate in robots.txt.
sents.zh: 仅针对广告的偏好无法用这种方式表达：Cloudflare 可以检测哪些页面投放了广告，但这份列表太庞大且变化过于频繁，无法在 robots.txt 中逐一列出。

sents.en: That's why there's no Disallow AI Training on pages with ads.
sents.zh: 这就是为什么对于投放广告的页面没有「禁止 AI 训练」选项。

paragraphs.en: Agents do not create the same search-discoverability tradeoff as mixed-use crawlers, and the Internet does not yet have a well-established directive for expressing Disallow preferences to agents. For now, we’re not including a Disallow setting for Agents. As standards such as ai-prefs mature, we will revisit this approach.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体不会造成与混合用途爬虫相同的搜索可发现性权衡，而互联网尚未有一个成熟的指令用于向智能体表达 Disallow 偏好。 目前，我们不会为智能体加入 Disallow 设置。 随着诸如 ai-prefs 之类的标准日趋成熟，我们将重新审视这一做法。

sents.en: Agents do not create the same search-discoverability tradeoff as mixed-use crawlers, and the Internet does not yet have a well-established directive for expressing Disallow preferences to agents.

sents.en: For now, we’re not including a Disallow setting for Agents.
sents.zh: 目前，我们不会为智能体加入 Disallow 设置。

sents.en: As standards such as ai-prefs mature, we will revisit this approach.
sents.zh: 随着诸如 ai-prefs 之类的标准日趋成熟，我们将重新审视这一做法。

paragraphs.en: We are making the following changes to Bot Management and AI Crawl Control:
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 Bot Management（机器人管理）和 AI Crawl Control（AI 爬虫控制）做出以下更改：

paragraphs.en: Nothing, in almost every case. Your current settings carry over on their own.
paragraphs.zh: 几乎在所有情况下，什么都不用做。 你当前的设置会自动延续。

sents.en: Nothing, in almost every case.
sents.zh: 几乎在所有情况下，什么都不用做。

sents.en: Your current settings carry over on their own.
sents.zh: 你当前的设置会自动延续。

paragraphs.en: If you want mixed-use crawlers gone entirely, you now have to say so. Select Block. It will stop Applebot, Bingbot, and Googlebot from reaching your site — search included.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你想让混合用途爬虫完全无法访问，现在必须明确说明。选择“阻止”。 它将阻止 Applebot、Bingbot 和 Googlebot 访问你的网站——包括搜索在内。

sents.en: If you want mixed-use crawlers gone entirely, you now have to say so. Select Block.
sents.zh: 如果你想让混合用途爬虫完全无法访问，现在必须明确说明。选择“阻止”。

sents.en: It will stop Applebot, Bingbot, and Googlebot from reaching your site — search included.
sents.zh: 它将阻止 Applebot、Bingbot 和 Googlebot 访问你的网站——包括搜索在内。

paragraphs.en: Site owners that never configured the more granular controls will be migrated to the new settings based on their legacy Block AI Bots setting:
paragraphs.zh: 从未配置过更细粒度控制的网站所有者，将根据其旧版「Block AI Bots」设置迁移到新设置中：

paragraphs.en: For domains that previously configured the granular controls, we will preserve the practical effect of their selections under the new definitions. Previous Training selections of Block or Block on pages with ads will migrate to Disallow AI Training.
paragraphs.zh: 对于此前配置了细粒度控制的域名，我们将根据新定义保留其选项的实际效果。 之前在训练设置中选择的「屏蔽」或「屏蔽带广告页面」将迁移为「禁止 AI 训练」。

sents.en: For domains that previously configured the granular controls, we will preserve the practical effect of their selections under the new definitions.
sents.zh: 对于此前配置了细粒度控制的域名，我们将根据新定义保留其选项的实际效果。

sents.en: Previous Training selections of Block or Block on pages with ads will migrate to Disallow AI Training.
sents.zh: 之前在训练设置中选择的「屏蔽」或「屏蔽带广告页面」将迁移为「禁止 AI 训练」。

paragraphs.en: Beginning September 15, customers onboarding a new domain will be offered one of two preset configurations, depending on whether the site earns money from advertising. Ad revenue depends on a human actually seeing the page. Training replaces that visit with an answer; agents fetch the page with nobody there to see the ads. So the presets for ad-supported sites are more restrictive. You can change any of these settings during onboarding, or at any time afterward.
paragraphs.zh: 自9月15日起，为新域名开通接入的客户将根据该网站是否通过广告获利，获得两种预设配置之一。 广告收入依赖于真人实际浏览页面。 训练用一个答案取代了这次访问；智能体抓取页面时，没有人会在那里看到广告。 因此，针对靠广告获利的网站的预设配置更为严格。 你可以在开通接入时更改这些设置，也可以在此后的任何时候更改。

sents.en: Beginning September 15, customers onboarding a new domain will be offered one of two preset configurations, depending on whether the site earns money from advertising.
sents.zh: 自9月15日起，为新域名开通接入的客户将根据该网站是否通过广告获利，获得两种预设配置之一。

sents.en: Ad revenue depends on a human actually seeing the page.
sents.zh: 广告收入依赖于真人实际浏览页面。

sents.en: Training replaces that visit with an answer; agents fetch the page with nobody there to see the ads.
sents.zh: 训练用一个答案取代了这次访问；智能体抓取页面时，没有人会在那里看到广告。

sents.en: So the presets for ad-supported sites are more restrictive.
sents.zh: 因此，针对靠广告获利的网站的预设配置更为严格。

sents.en: You can change any of these settings during onboarding, or at any time afterward.
sents.zh: 你可以在开通接入时更改这些设置，也可以在此后的任何时候更改。

paragraphs.en: Applebot, Bingbot, and Googlebot are Accountable. Apple, Google, and Microsoft are committed to the same principles of publisher choice and transparency. Under Disallow AI Training they can keep crawling your site for search. Selecting Block stops them entirely.
paragraphs.zh: Applebot、Bingbot 和 Googlebot 属于「可追责」类别。 Apple、Google 和 Microsoft 均致力于出版商选择权与透明度等相同原则。 在「禁止 AI 训练」设置下，它们仍可为搜索目的继续抓取您的网站。 选择「屏蔽」则会完全阻止它们。

sents.en: Applebot, Bingbot, and Googlebot are Accountable.
sents.zh: Applebot、Bingbot 和 Googlebot 属于「可追责」类别。

sents.en: Apple, Google, and Microsoft are committed to the same principles of publisher choice and transparency.
sents.zh: Apple、Google 和 Microsoft 均致力于出版商选择权与透明度等相同原则。

sents.en: Under Disallow AI Training they can keep crawling your site for search.
sents.zh: 在「禁止 AI 训练」设置下，它们仍可为搜索目的继续抓取您的网站。

sents.en: Selecting Block stops them entirely.
sents.zh: 选择「屏蔽」则会完全阻止它们。

paragraphs.en: We also categorize the relevant crawlers from Amazon, Anthropic, Meta, and OpenAI as Accountable. These organizations separate their Search and Training crawlers, so Cloudflare can block the Training crawler without affecting search.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还将来自 Amazon、Anthropic、Meta 和 OpenAI 的相关爬虫归类为「可问责」类型。 这些组织将其搜索爬虫与训练爬虫分开，因此 Cloudflare 可以在不影响搜索的情况下封锁训练爬虫。

sents.en: We also categorize the relevant crawlers from Amazon, Anthropic, Meta, and OpenAI as Accountable.
sents.zh: 我们还将来自 Amazon、Anthropic、Meta 和 OpenAI 的相关爬虫归类为「可问责」类型。

sents.en: These organizations separate their Search and Training crawlers, so Cloudflare can block the Training crawler without affecting search.
sents.zh: 这些组织将其搜索爬虫与训练爬虫分开，因此 Cloudflare 可以在不影响搜索的情况下封锁训练爬虫。

paragraphs.en: Applebot allows site owners to opt out of training by adding a Disallow rule to robots.txt for “Applebot-Extended”. Site owners can also currently express preferences for AI Summaries via their nosnippet directive in the page HTML. Content can also be labeled as paywalled content to exclude it from generative output. Applebot does not yet provide a tool for URL-level inspection. However, we have met with their team, and they have shared details of their in-progress solution for next year. Apple has also stated that disallowing training does not impact search ranking .
paragraphs.zh: Applebot 允许网站所有者在 robots.txt 中为「Applebot-Extended」添加 Disallow 规则，以选择退出训练。 网站所有者目前还可以通过页面 HTML 中的 nosnippet 指令来表达对 AI 摘要的偏好。 内容也可以被标记为付费墙内容，从而将其排除在生成式输出之外。 Applebot 尚未提供 URL 级别的检查工具。 不过，我们已与他们的团队会面，他们分享了其正在开发的明年解决方案的细节。 Apple 也已表示，禁止训练不会影响搜索排名。

sents.en: Applebot allows site owners to opt out of training by adding a Disallow rule to robots.txt for “Applebot-Extended”.
sents.zh: Applebot 允许网站所有者在 robots.txt 中为「Applebot-Extended」添加 Disallow 规则，以选择退出训练。

sents.en: Site owners can also currently express preferences for AI Summaries via their nosnippet directive in the page HTML.
sents.zh: 网站所有者目前还可以通过页面 HTML 中的 nosnippet 指令来表达对 AI 摘要的偏好。

sents.en: Content can also be labeled as paywalled content to exclude it from generative output.
sents.zh: 内容也可以被标记为付费墙内容，从而将其排除在生成式输出之外。

sents.en: Applebot does not yet provide a tool for URL-level inspection.
sents.zh: Applebot 尚未提供 URL 级别的检查工具。

sents.en: However, we have met with their team, and they have shared details of their in-progress solution for next year.
sents.zh: 不过，我们已与他们的团队会面，他们分享了其正在开发的明年解决方案的细节。

sents.en: Apple has also stated that disallowing training does not impact search ranking .
sents.zh: Apple 也已表示，禁止训练不会影响搜索排名。

paragraphs.en: Googlebot allows site owners to opt out of training by adding a Disallow rule to robots.txt for “Google-Extended”, and they provide a toggle inside their webmaster portal to exclude a site’s content from generative search results. Googlebot also provides site owners with metrics and reporting regarding search results and AI summary results. Google shared information about their existing and recently launched controls, as well as information about what they're already working on, including additional URL-level transparency tools for site-owners related to Google-Extended, which they expect to launch in the weeks to come. Google has also stated that disallowing Google-Extended does not impact search ranking .
paragraphs.zh: Googlebot 允许网站所有者在 robots.txt 中为“Google-Extended”添加 Disallow 规则以选择退出训练，并且在他们的网站管理员门户中提供了一个开关，用于将网站内容排除在生成式搜索结果之外。 Googlebot 还为网站所有者提供有关搜索结果和 AI 摘要结果的指标与报告。 Google 分享了其现有及近期推出的控制功能的相关信息，以及他们目前正在进行的工作的信息，包括为网站所有者提供的与 Google-Extended 相关的更多 URL 级别透明度工具，他们预计将在未来几周内推出这些工具。 Google 还表示，禁止 Google-Extended 不会影响搜索排名。

sents.en: Googlebot allows site owners to opt out of training by adding a Disallow rule to robots.txt for “Google-Extended”, and they provide a toggle inside their webmaster portal to exclude a site’s content from generative search results.
sents.zh: Googlebot 允许网站所有者在 robots.txt 中为“Google-Extended”添加 Disallow 规则以选择退出训练，并且在他们的网站管理员门户中提供了一个开关，用于将网站内容排除在生成式搜索结果之外。

sents.en: Googlebot also provides site owners with metrics and reporting regarding search results and AI summary results.
sents.zh: Googlebot 还为网站所有者提供有关搜索结果和 AI 摘要结果的指标与报告。

sents.en: Google shared information about their existing and recently launched controls, as well as information about what they're already working on, including additional URL-level transparency tools for site-owners related to Google-Extended, which they expect to launch in the weeks to come.
sents.zh: Google 分享了其现有及近期推出的控制功能的相关信息，以及他们目前正在进行的工作的信息，包括为网站所有者提供的与 Google-Extended 相关的更多 URL 级别透明度工具，他们预计将在未来几周内推出这些工具。

sents.en: Google has also stated that disallowing Google-Extended does not impact search ranking .
sents.zh: Google 还表示，禁止 Google-Extended 不会影响搜索排名。

paragraphs.en: Bingbot provides granular controls and transparency in their Webmaster Tools . Site owners can currently express AI training preferences through Bing’s NOARCHIVE meta tag . Microsoft is extending these capabilities and currently building the mechanism to also respect a “no training” preference in robots.txt at the domain/site level, targeted for early 2027. For Cloudflare Customers who wish to opt out of training in Bing today, in addition to using the NOARCHIVE tag, site owners can use the Block URLs or Content Removal tool . Microsoft has also stated that using NOARCHIVE will not impact search ranking .
paragraphs.zh: Bingbot 在其网站管理员工具中提供了细粒度的控制与透明度。 网站所有者目前可以通过 Bing 的 NOARCHIVE 元标签来表达关于 AI 训练的偏好。 Microsoft 正在扩展这些功能，目前正在构建相关机制，以在域名/站点级别的 robots.txt 中同样尊重“禁止训练”的偏好，目标是在 2027 年初实现。 对于今天希望退出 Bing 训练的 Cloudflare 客户，除了使用 NOARCHIVE 标签外，网站所有者还可以使用阻止网址或内容删除工具。 Microsoft 还表示，使用 NOARCHIVE 不会影响搜索排名。

sents.en: Bingbot provides granular controls and transparency in their Webmaster Tools .
sents.zh: Bingbot 在其网站管理员工具中提供了细粒度的控制与透明度。

sents.en: Site owners can currently express AI training preferences through Bing’s NOARCHIVE meta tag .
sents.zh: 网站所有者目前可以通过 Bing 的 NOARCHIVE 元标签来表达关于 AI 训练的偏好。

sents.en: Microsoft is extending these capabilities and currently building the mechanism to also respect a “no training” preference in robots.txt at the domain/site level, targeted for early 2027.
sents.zh: Microsoft 正在扩展这些功能，目前正在构建相关机制，以在域名/站点级别的 robots.txt 中同样尊重“禁止训练”的偏好，目标是在 2027 年初实现。

sents.en: For Cloudflare Customers who wish to opt out of training in Bing today, in addition to using the NOARCHIVE tag, site owners can use the Block URLs or Content Removal tool .
sents.zh: 对于今天希望退出 Bing 训练的 Cloudflare 客户，除了使用 NOARCHIVE 标签外，网站所有者还可以使用阻止网址或内容删除工具。

sents.en: Microsoft has also stated that using NOARCHIVE will not impact search ranking .
sents.zh: Microsoft 还表示，使用 NOARCHIVE 不会影响搜索排名。

paragraphs.en: Until that support launches, selecting Disallow AI Training will not automatically convey a no-training preference to Bing through robots.txt. This is the same practical behavior as the previous Training Block setting, which did not apply to mixed-use crawlers such as Bingbot.
paragraphs.zh: 在该支持上线之前，选择“禁止 AI 训练”（Disallow AI Training）不会通过 robots.txt 自动向 Bing 传达禁止训练的偏好。 这与之前的“训练阻止”（Training Block）设置的实际行为相同，该设置并不适用于 Bingbot 这类混合用途的爬虫。

sents.en: Until that support launches, selecting Disallow AI Training will not automatically convey a no-training preference to Bing through robots.txt.
sents.zh: 在该支持上线之前，选择“禁止 AI 训练”（Disallow AI Training）不会通过 robots.txt 自动向 Bing 传达禁止训练的偏好。

sents.en: This is the same practical behavior as the previous Training Block setting, which did not apply to mixed-use crawlers such as Bingbot.
sents.zh: 这与之前的“训练阻止”（Training Block）设置的实际行为相同，该设置并不适用于 Bingbot 这类混合用途的爬虫。

paragraphs.en: We will continue to reach out and engage with all operators of AI crawlers as these capabilities evolve. Cloudflare Radar publicly tracks the controls, transparency, and reporting provided by Accountable crawler operators.
paragraphs.zh: 随着这些能力不断演进，我们将继续联系并接洽所有 AI 爬虫的运营方。 Cloudflare Radar 公开追踪负责任的爬虫运营方所提供的控制、透明度和报告情况。

sents.en: We will continue to reach out and engage with all operators of AI crawlers as these capabilities evolve.
sents.zh: 随着这些能力不断演进，我们将继续联系并接洽所有 AI 爬虫的运营方。

sents.en: Cloudflare Radar publicly tracks the controls, transparency, and reporting provided by Accountable crawler operators.
sents.zh: Cloudflare Radar 公开追踪负责任的爬虫运营方所提供的控制、透明度和报告情况。

paragraphs.en: Making the Internet better requires both sides to have agency: crawlers need access to the open web, and the people who create that web need meaningful control over how their work is used. Today’s announcement represents concrete progress toward that balance.
paragraphs.zh: 让互联网变得更好，需要双方都拥有能动性：爬虫需要访问开放网络，而创建这个网络的人需要对其作品的使用方式拥有切实的控制权。 今天的公告代表了朝着这一平衡迈出的具体进展。

sents.en: Making the Internet better requires both sides to have agency: crawlers need access to the open web, and the people who create that web need meaningful control over how their work is used.
sents.zh: 让互联网变得更好，需要双方都拥有能动性：爬虫需要访问开放网络，而创建这个网络的人需要对其作品的使用方式拥有切实的控制权。

sents.en: Today’s announcement represents concrete progress toward that balance.
sents.zh: 今天的公告代表了朝着这一平衡迈出的具体进展。

paragraphs.en: Progress requires infrastructure providers, content creators, technology companies, and standards bodies such as the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) working together to translate these principles into open, interoperable standards.
paragraphs.zh: 进步需要基础设施提供商、内容创作者、技术公司以及互联网工程任务组（IETF）等标准组织共同努力，将这些原则转化为开放、可互操作的标准。

paragraphs.en: Training and AI Summaries raise different questions for site owners. Training concerns whether content can be used to build AI models. Summaries affect how people discover, evaluate, and ultimately visit a business. Both matter, but they affect businesses in different ways.
paragraphs.zh: 训练与AI摘要给网站所有者带来了不同的问题。 训练涉及内容是否可以被用来构建AI模型。 摘要则影响人们如何发现、评估并最终访问一家企业。 两者都很重要，但它们以不同的方式影响企业。

sents.en: Training and AI Summaries raise different questions for site owners.
sents.zh: 训练与AI摘要给网站所有者带来了不同的问题。

sents.en: Training concerns whether content can be used to build AI models.
sents.zh: 训练涉及内容是否可以被用来构建AI模型。

sents.en: Summaries affect how people discover, evaluate, and ultimately visit a business.
sents.zh: 摘要则影响人们如何发现、评估并最终访问一家企业。

sents.en: Both matter, but they affect businesses in different ways.
sents.zh: 两者都很重要，但它们以不同的方式影响企业。

paragraphs.en: Controls to opt out of AI summaries are the first step. The operators identified as Accountable either provide or are completing work to provide that capability, establishing an important baseline: site owners can say no.
paragraphs.zh: 用于选择不使用 AI 摘要的控件是第一步。 被认定为承担问责责任的运营商要么已经提供该能力，要么正在完成相关工作以提供该能力，从而确立了一个重要的基线：网站所有者可以说不。

sents.en: Controls to opt out of AI summaries are the first step.
sents.zh: 用于选择不使用 AI 摘要的控件是第一步。

sents.en: The operators identified as Accountable either provide or are completing work to provide that capability, establishing an important baseline: site owners can say no.
sents.zh: 被认定为承担问责责任的运营商要么已经提供该能力，要么正在完成相关工作以提供该能力，从而确立了一个重要的基线：网站所有者可以说不。

paragraphs.en: But a site-wide choice between allowing and prohibiting summaries is still a blunt instrument. The right decision depends on the site, the content, and the business outcome. For publishers, training raises foundational questions about control, compensation, and the sustainability of original content. Summaries create a separate and often more immediate distribution question: does someone visit the publisher’s site, or consume the answer within a search or AI experience? For many other businesses, AI summaries increasingly sit between a potential customer and a website. They may answer a question, compare alternatives, recommend a product, or help someone decide whether to visit at all.
paragraphs.zh: 但在全站范围内一刀切地允许或禁止摘要，仍然是一种粗糙的手段。 正确的决定取决于网站、内容以及业务结果。 对出版商而言，训练提出了关于控制权、报酬以及原创内容可持续性的根本性问题。 摘要还引出了一个独立且往往更为紧迫的分发问题：用户是访问出版商的网站，还是在搜索或AI体验中直接获取答案？ 对许多其他企业来说，AI摘要越来越多地出现在潜在客户与网站之间。 它们可能回答问题、比较不同选项、推荐产品，或者帮助用户决定是否真的需要访问网站。

sents.en: But a site-wide choice between allowing and prohibiting summaries is still a blunt instrument.
sents.zh: 但在全站范围内一刀切地允许或禁止摘要，仍然是一种粗糙的手段。

sents.en: The right decision depends on the site, the content, and the business outcome.
sents.zh: 正确的决定取决于网站、内容以及业务结果。

sents.en: For publishers, training raises foundational questions about control, compensation, and the sustainability of original content.
sents.zh: 对出版商而言，训练提出了关于控制权、报酬以及原创内容可持续性的根本性问题。

sents.en: Summaries create a separate and often more immediate distribution question: does someone visit the publisher’s site, or consume the answer within a search or AI experience?
sents.zh: 摘要还引出了一个独立且往往更为紧迫的分发问题：用户是访问出版商的网站，还是在搜索或AI体验中直接获取答案？

sents.en: For many other businesses, AI summaries increasingly sit between a potential customer and a website.
sents.zh: 对许多其他企业来说，AI摘要越来越多地出现在潜在客户与网站之间。

sents.en: They may answer a question, compare alternatives, recommend a product, or help someone decide whether to visit at all.
sents.zh: 它们可能回答问题、比较不同选项、推荐产品，或者帮助用户决定是否真的需要访问网站。

paragraphs.en: The data illustrates mixed impact. More than half of consumers read summaries in Search, and those consumers are over 40% more likely to end their search after reading one. This can reduce the number of visits a website receives. But consumers referred by AI Search convert at between three times and over five times the rate of those referred by traditional search. AI may produce fewer visits while sending customers with much greater intent.
paragraphs.zh: 数据显示影响是好坏参半的。 超过一半的消费者会阅读搜索中的摘要，而这些消费者在阅读摘要后结束搜索的可能性高出 40% 以上。 这可能会减少网站收到的访问次数。 但由 AI 搜索引流的消费者的转化率是传统搜索引流消费者的三倍到五倍以上。 AI 可能带来更少的访问量，但送来的客户意向要强烈得多。

sents.en: The data illustrates mixed impact.
sents.zh: 数据显示影响是好坏参半的。

sents.en: More than half of consumers read summaries in Search, and those consumers are over 40% more likely to end their search after reading one.
sents.zh: 超过一半的消费者会阅读搜索中的摘要，而这些消费者在阅读摘要后结束搜索的可能性高出 40% 以上。

sents.en: This can reduce the number of visits a website receives.
sents.zh: 这可能会减少网站收到的访问次数。

sents.en: But consumers referred by AI Search convert at between three times and over five times the rate of those referred by traditional search.
sents.zh: 但由 AI 搜索引流的消费者的转化率是传统搜索引流消费者的三倍到五倍以上。

sents.en: AI may produce fewer visits while sending customers with much greater intent.
sents.zh: AI 可能带来更少的访问量，但送来的客户意向要强烈得多。

paragraphs.en: That is not inherently good or bad. A publisher funded by advertising may optimize for audience volume. A retailer may prefer fewer visitors who are more likely to purchase. Cloudflare’s role is not to choose for them, but to provide the visibility and control needed to make an informed decision.
paragraphs.zh: 这本身并无好坏之分。 靠广告资助的出版商可能会以受众数量为优化目标。 零售商可能更倾向于访客数量较少但购买可能性更高的群体。 Cloudflare 的角色不是替他们做出选择，而是提供做出明智决策所需的可见性与控制能力。

sents.en: That is not inherently good or bad.
sents.zh: 这本身并无好坏之分。

sents.en: A publisher funded by advertising may optimize for audience volume.
sents.zh: 靠广告资助的出版商可能会以受众数量为优化目标。

sents.en: A retailer may prefer fewer visitors who are more likely to purchase.
sents.zh: 零售商可能更倾向于访客数量较少但购买可能性更高的群体。

sents.en: Cloudflare’s role is not to choose for them, but to provide the visibility and control needed to make an informed decision.
sents.zh: Cloudflare 的角色不是替他们做出选择，而是提供做出明智决策所需的可见性与控制能力。

paragraphs.en: Summary opt-outs are a strong start, but they are not the end state. Our next focus is helping site owners understand how summaries affect their businesses and giving them more control over how much of their content can be used. Open standards such as ai-prefs will be an important part of making that possible.
